# Wait for status feedback cleanup as well as network idle

Historical386 waits pending start,spinning,and stop feedback state after protocol idle, with explicit request/process assertions. Current helper waits protocol-specific IMAP/POP/NNTP idle then clearStatusBar(window). Network idle does not prove UI timer/process completion. Use current shared cleanup helper rather than copying the historical inline fields into every test. Test code was read, not run; repeated-alert310 remains a separate unresolved issue.

Scope: view.
